'''Firehawk''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]], Firehawk was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] along with [[Mynock (SIS)|Mynock]]. However, his partner disappeared while he escaped with several Republic traitors. He tasked a Republic spacer to find out what happened to his partner.<ref name="TOR" />
